mapper.sql:
FROM PREDICTION P JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_ID = P.MEMBER_ID LEFT JOIN PREDICTION_INPUT I ON I.PREDICTION_ID = P.PREDICTION_ID
AND M.EMAIL LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%'
AND P.TAX_YEAR = #{taxYear}
AND P.SCENARIO_NAME = '현재'
AND P.SCENARIO_NAME <> '현재'
mapper.select:
SELECT P.PREDICTION_ID AS predictionId, P.MEMBER_ID AS memberId, CASE WHEN INSTR(M.EMAIL, '@') <= 3 THEN '***' || SUBSTR(M.EMAIL, INSTR(M.EMAIL, '@')) ELSE REGEXP_REPLACE(M.EMAIL, '^([^@]{2})[^@]*(@.*)$', '\1***\2') END AS email, P.TAX_YEAR AS taxYear, P.SCENARIO_NAME AS scenarioName, P.BASE_PREDICTION_ID AS basePredictionId, I.TOTAL_SALARY AS totalSalary, P.TAXABLE_INCOME AS taxableIncome, P.CALCULATED_TAX AS calculatedTax, P.DECIDED_TAX AS decidedTax, P.EXPECTED_REFUND AS expectedRefund, TO_CHAR(P.PREDICTED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS predictedAt
ORDER BY P.PREDICTED_AT DESC, P.PREDICTION_ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
